mentions.name: Flopper
mentions.description: A site building a holistic view of the GPU market, aggregating providers, rental prices, vendor information and GPU specs. It includes tools such as an LLM GPU calculator that estimates how many GPUs are needed to run a given model based on power/flops, precision, context length, concurrency and other requirements.
mentions.problem: GPU market information is scattered across providers and vendors, making it hard to compare specs and estimate how many GPUs are needed to run a certain model.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Still plugging away on Flopper to build a holistic view of the GPU market including providers, rental prices, vendor information and mostly - specs for GPUs.

Added a way to look at power/flops and new model requirements lately to try and estimate how many GPUs you need to run a certain model: https://flopper.io/tools/llm-gpu-calculator?model=llama-3-3-70b-instruct&precision=bf16&ctx=32768&conc=32&tps=1000&out=512&cache=50
mentions.author: triwats
